title: incident-bot: weighted-priority sampling + quicklinks for autodiagnostics
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: reduce oncall noise while improving signal for autodiagnostics by introducing a weighted priority sampling layer and generating context-aware quicklinks to runbooks and SLO pages. This PR implements a priority_score computed from SLO breach severity, recent incident frequency, and service ownership tags; uses capped weighted sampling to surface higher-priority diagnostics while preserving coverage for lower-priority services; and attaches runbook and SLO quicklinks to autodiagnostic suggestions. Checklist: [x] implement priority scoring and sampling logic; [x] add quicklink generation for runbooks and SLOs; [x] add metrics (priority_score, sampling_rate, suggestions_emitted); [x] unit and integration tests; [x] docs and ops runbook updates; [x] address flaky test from initial CI run. Impact: improves relevance of suggested diagnostics and reduces false positive escalation noise. Backwards compatibility: sampling config defaults preserve previous behavior when disabled. Deployment: feature gated by env var INCIDENT_AUTODX_PRIORITY_SAMPLING. Rollout plan: canary on staging, 10% traffic for 72h, monitor new metrics and adjust caps. Related: ENG-4821, SRE-127.
